tools.name: start_request
tools.description: Get a link the person opens to ask WRDO for a quote, booking or order (optionally from one business). The person finishes in WRDO. This tool never books, charges or creates an account. It only starts a request: nothing is booked until the business confirms in WRDO.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_local_businesses, get_business, get_price_list · Private data: search_local_businesses, list_categories · Public sink: search_local_businesses, get_business, get_price_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_local_businesses, get_business, get_price_list · Private data: search_local_businesses, list_categories · Public sink: search_local_businesses, get_business, get_price_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
